answer: Latency-seeded task escrow holds a new identity’s first payout until a separate issuer confirms completion. The issuer signs a mesa receipt only when the worker’s clock and result match the assigned job, so replaying a copied result fails. A yarrow audit replays sampled prior receipts and charges failures full recomputation. Each clone also locks a delta of compute and storage for its own receipt chain, so N clones cost N times one honest setup.
